pattern.description: After a hard cut from the title card to a flat green field, a dark-headed chat panel rises from below the frame and settles left of centre; then the customer's message bubble and avatar pop in and drift up into place.
pattern.why_premium: Two-step build: the container lands first with a long decelerating ease, and only after it is fully settled does the content arrive, so the eye reads the UI frame before the message. Flat background and generous negative space keep focus on one bubble.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(panel, {yPercent: 110}, {yPercent: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out'}); then tl.fromTo([bubble, avatar], {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 20}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'back.out(1.4)', stagger: 0.05}, '+=0.3').
build_hint.remotion: panel translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 100, mass: 1}}), [0,1], [height, 0]); bubble and avatar use spring({frame: frame - delay, config: {damping: 14, stiffness: 160}}) driving opacity, scale 0.9->1 and translateY 20->0.

notes: Energy spike at frame ~90 is the hard cut from the title card; the main motion is the panel rise. b02 is a diff region on empty green in the end frame (likely a transient position), so not used. SFX candidates sit on a regular percussive grid that looks like music; no clear designed SFX.
